The container is a large metal mixing bowl, perhaps 28 cm across at the rim. The pizza pieces sit at the bottom, where the bowl is narrower.

There are two small rectangular pizza pieces, each about 6 cm by 8 cm. Each is about 1 cm thick, so roughly 48 cm³. At about 0.6 g/cm³ for pizza, that is around 30–40 g each, or about 70 g for both.

Pepperoni appears on the pieces as slices partly visible. I'm counting it as part of the pizza weight rather than a separate item.
